commit.message:
8395930: apply null check in disposeRecursively

This issue was introduced with changes for JDK-8381236.

Prior to JDK-8381236:
CAccessible.getCAccessible(..) would throw a NPE of you passed in an Accessible object x where `x.getAccessibleContext() == null`. That behavior didn't change, so to prevent unintended consequences: let's preserve that behavior (and document it).

To resolve this NPE:
Let's instead focus on not calling `getCAccessible(..)` for Accessible objects that have a null AccessibleContext.

Revert "8395930: avoid NPE for null axContext"

This reverts commit 1eb8f9a0dc5ee1a5dabbcffe34e03c00e3867041.

8395930: avoid NPE for null axContext

The stacktrace being resolved resembles:

java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot read field "nativeAXResource" because "accessibleContext" is null
at java.desktop/javax.accessibility.AccessibleContext$1.getNativeAXResource(AccessibleContext.java:90)
at java.desktop/sun.lwawt.macosx.CAccessible.getCAccessible(CAccessible.java:74)
at java.desktop/sun.lwawt.macosx.CAccessible$1.disposeRecursively(CAccessible.java:104)
at java.desktop/sun.lwawt.macosx.CAccessible$1.eventDispatched(CAccessible.java:93)
